mentions.name: fluxmail-mcp
mentions.description: A self-hosted MCP server that gives AI agents access to email. Supports connecting multiple accounts, even across different email providers, through a unified API, and works with any AI agent including self-built ones. Currently supports Gmail API and IMAP/SMTP, with Outlook/Microsoft Graph coming soon.
mentions.problem: Hosted email connectors like ChatGPT or Claude don't preserve privacy; this offers a privacy-preserving way for AI agents to access email.
mentions.audience: People who want AI agents to access their email, including those building their own agents
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a self-hosted MCP server to give your AI agents access to email: https://github.com/churichard/fluxmail-mcp
